data.description:
Ihre Karriere in der Automatisierungstechnik industrieller Prozessanlagen.

Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING planen und realisieren Sie anspruchsvolle Automatisierungsprojekte für verfahrenstechnische Produktionsanlagen. Sie begleiten Projekte vom Basic- und Detailengineering über die technische Auslegung und Projektsteuerung bis zur Inbetriebnahme und sorgen für eine zuverlässige Automatisierung, Mess- und Regelungstechnik sowie sichere OT-Infrastrukturen.

Aufgaben

  • Projektierung: Sie bearbeiten und leiten Projekte mit Schwerpunkt Automatisierungstechnik sowie Mess-, Regelungs- und Steuerungstechnik im Bereich verfahrenstechnischer Produktionsanlagen
  • Projektsteuerung: Sie planen Ressourcen, Kosten und Termine und dokumentieren den Projektfortschritt im Projektmanagementsystem
  • Engineering: Sie führen Machbarkeitsstudien sowie Basic- und Detailengineering durch, erstellen technische Ausschreibungsunterlagen und bewerten Angebote zu Investitionsentscheidungen
  • Systemauslegung: Sie konzipieren Automatisierungs- und OT-Netzwerksysteme sowie Mess-, Regelungs- und Maschinensicherheitseinrichtungen
  • Monitoring: Sie koordinieren die Ausführung vor Ort und begleiten Montage, Bauleitung und Inbetriebnahme der technischen Systeme
  • Konformität: Sie berücksichtigen geltende Vorschriften und technische Standards und wirken bei der Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung interner Vorgaben mit

Qualifikation

  • Qualifikation: Abgeschlossene elektrotechnische Berufsausbildung sowie Studium oder Weiterbildung als staatlich geprüfte:r Techniker:in in Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung und erfüllen die Voraussetzungen zur Ernennung zur Elektrofachkraft gemäß DIN VDE 1000-10
  • Projekterfahrung: Erfahrung in der Planung und Koordination elektrotechnischer Projekte an industriellen Produktionsanlagen
  • Automatisierung: Kenntnisse in Automatisierungssystemen wie Siemens SIMATIC S7, PCS 7 oder Valmet DNA
  • Programmierung: Erfahrung in Programmierung und Diagnose von Prozessleitsystemen, beispielsweise mit TIA Portal oder Valmet DNA Explorer
  • Elektroplanung: Grundkenntnisse in der Erstellung elektrotechnischer Planungsunterlagen mit eCAD-Systemen wie COMOS oder EPLAN
  • Arbeitsweise: Technisches Verständnis sowie eine strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Vorgehensweise

Benefits

  • Attraktive Konditionen: Freuen Sie sich auf eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle bei BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
  • Zukunftssichere Projekte: Arbeiten Sie an anspruchsvollen Automatisierungsprojekten für moderne verfahrenstechnische Produktionsanlagen und begleiten Sie diese vom Engineering bis zur Inbetriebnahme
  • Dynamisches Team: Werden Sie Teil eines Teams, das Wert auf fachlichen Austausch, persönliche Weiterentwicklung und gegenseitige Unterstützung legt

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit
Angabe Ihres frühesten Starttermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung.

Ihr Ansprechpartner für Ihre Bewerbung ist:
Dipl.-Wirt.-Ing. Thorsten Schermann

data.description:
Senior Product Designer – Sell Online

About the team

The Sell Online team builds the products that help small business owners run and grow their businesses online — from appointment bookings and online stores to customer management. We're a cross-functional design team embedded across multiple product squads, working closely with product managers and engineers to shape experiences used by millions of merchants worldwide. As we expand our portfolio and grow our engineering capacity, we're looking for a Senior Product Designer who can bring strong visual craft, product thinking, and the confidence to own complex design challenges across several product areas simultaneously.

🎥 Get a feel for our Berlin office: Take a look

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end design across our Bookings and Online Store products — from early-stage concepts and user flows through to polished, high-fidelity UI ready for development
  • Craft visually compelling interfaces, including iconography and illustrations, that raise the bar for quality and consistency across the portfolio
  • Work across multiple squads simultaneously, collaborating closely with product managers, engineers and other designers to keep design and delivery in sync
  • Contribute to and evolve our design system, ensuring consistency and scalability as the product portfolio grows
  • Use qualitative research and user data to inform design decisions and validate solutions — bringing a user-centred lens to everything you ship

You'll be great for this role if…

  • You have a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design — from wireframes and user flows to high-fidelity UI — with a clear emphasis on visual craft, typography, and layout
  • You have experience designing for customer-facing products on both web and mobile, ideally in e-commerce, bookings, or similar consumer contexts
  • You have proven ability to work with and contribute to design systems at scale
  • You are comfortable with managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders across different product areas at the same time
  • You have a collaborative, curious mindset — someone who listens well, adapts quickly, and can navigate ambiguity without losing momentum

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup
🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education
💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions
🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days
🏋️ Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches
🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.

Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

data.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

As part of our Mobile App Platform team, you will own the quality strategy of our Flutter apps, and change how we approach testing.

AI-driven QA is the differentiator in this role. Our QA team already uses AI for test generation, but we want to go much further. You will help reinvent it: autonomous exploration, smarter test orchestration, self-directed QA workflows, and QA systems that detect product risks before they reach users.

This is not a "write test cases and file tickets" role. You co-create systems and practices that enable our product teams to own product quality end-to-end and work with them to close the gaps so we can ship with confidence. Speed boost instead of speed bump.
You think about quality as something you design into the product and process, not a checklist you run before release, effectively shifting quality assurance left.

Our Stack

  • Flutter & Dart
  • Appium, BrowserStack
  • Testmo for test case management
  • GCP, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly
  • AI-assisted development with Cursor and agentic coding workflows
  • Linear, Notion, Figma, Miro Key Responsibilities
  • App Platform Quality Ownership: Own the quality strategy of our Flutter apps and testing architecture across our mobile product teams from a platform standpoint, including test strategy, execution, and production monitoring
  • Platform Collaboration & Support: Partner closely with cross-functional mobile product teams to shape quality practices, close testing gaps, and enable teams to ship with confidence
  • Automated Test Suite Management: Grow and maintain our automated test suite (Appium / BrowserStack), keeping it fast, stable, trusted, and focused on critical user journeys
  • Test Infrastructure Health: Keep test infrastructure healthy with minimized flakiness, faster runs, and actionable results for the entire engineering organization
  • Autonomous & AI-Driven Exploration: Create and scale autonomous exploration, intelligent test orchestration, and self-directed testing workflows from scratch to detect product risks before they reach users

Dein Profil

  • User-Centric Quality Focus: Strong focus on real-world user journeys, edge cases, and product risk rather than relying solely on code coverage metrics
  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: High initiative and problem-solving drive to invent solutions from scratch when no standard playbook exists
  • QA Architecture & Mobile Automation: Extensive experience designing scalable testing strategies and hands-on expertise with mobile automation frameworks (Appium, Flutter integration testing) and cloud device farms (BrowserStack)
  • Practical AI & Agentic Workflows: Active experience leveraging AI tools, LLM workflows, and testing agents for autonomous exploration, automated test generation, and defect analysis
  • CI/CD & Platform Enablement: Proven track record of integrating test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to deliver fast quality signals and co-creating practices that enable product teams to own quality without sacrificing velocity
  • User-Centric Quality & Communication: Focus on real-world user journeys and risk mitigation over simple coverage metrics, backed by strong English communication skills to guide engineering practices Bonus points for:
  • German language skills
  • Experience with energy systems, IoT, or climate tech
  • Native iOS/Android or deep Flutter/Dart architecture knowledge
  • Track record of navigating ambiguity
  • Experience in building testing tools from scratch

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

data.description:
Let us give you a taste

Werde Teil unserer Mission, die Food-Tech-Branche zu revolutionieren, und schließ' dich einer der am schnellsten wachsenden Restaurant-Discovery-Apps an!

Deine Mission:

  • Ad-hoc-Engagement-Kampagnen: Du planst, verfasst und setzt Newsletter-Initiativen um, die gezielt die Nutzerinteraktion in unserer B2C-App-Community in Deutschland, Österreich, den Niederlanden und Großbritannien steigern.

  • Kreatives Copywriting: Du erstellst mitreißende und conversionstarke CRM-Texte, die unsere food-begeisterte Zielgruppe direkt ansprechen und perfekt zur Brand von NeoTaste passen.

  • CRM-Tool-Operations: Du erstellst und versendest Kampagnennachrichten über moderne CRM-Plattformen - Bei NeoTaste nutzen wir Braze.

  • Testing & Analyse: Du testest laufend neue Content- und Kampagnen-Ideen und analysierst die relevanten CRM-KPIs über den gesamten Lifecycle hinweg, von Open & Click Rates über Conversion bis zu Retention und Reaktivierung. Daraus leitest du konkrete Maßnahmen ab, um Engagement und User Retention nachhaltig zu steigern.

Data Scientist (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities 

  • Systems thinker: Designs solutions with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind 

  • Pragmatic decision-making: Balances technical excellence with speed and business impact 

  • Ownership & accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs 

  • Clear communicator: Able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

data.description:
Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet?

We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.

Our global team of 500 drives things forward collaboratively, takes personal responsibility, values constructive critical thinking, and is dedicated to serving our customers and planet.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Data Science & Analytics team. You will own the forecasting and price elasticity models at the core of rebuy's pricing engine models that directly shape commercial decisions across the business. We care about outcomes, not just predictions: the work you do ships and moves the numbers that matter. We're scaling our impact significantly and need your expertise to take these models further.

You'll own the full end-to-end lifecycle: from business context and model research to automated pipelines and retraining, working closely with senior leadership to translate model insights into commercial strategy.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end forecasting and price-elasticity models at the core of our pricing engine — from feature and model research through evaluation, deployment, and continuous monitoring

  • Scale the forecasting architecture to meet growing demand for granular, product-level forecasts

  • Design and run pricing experiments and A/B tests, and turn the results into clear, strategic recommendations for leadership

  • Generate commercial insights through deep-dive analyses of pricing elasticity, customer behavior, market dynamics, and competitive positioning

  • Partner with senior stakeholders across Commercial, Marketing, Product, and Operations to surface opportunities and solve complex business problems

  • Establish best practices for analytics, experimentation, commercial decision-making, and AI usage — and automate the reporting that keeps models and decisions visible


Requirements:

  • 5+ years in a Data Science role, ideally in e-commerce or marketplace environments, solving a range of real business problems (we care about what you've built, not your exact title or tenure)

  • A quantitative degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field

  • Strong foundations in statistics, predictive modeling, and machine learning, with hands-on Python and SQL

  • Hands-on experience with time series forecasting — modeling, feature engineering, and evaluation

  • Experience designing and running A/B tests and experiments with measurable business impact

  • A proactive, self-starting mindset — you own a domain end-to-end and care about pricing, forecasting, and e-commerce dynamics

  • Strong stakeholder management and comfort presenting to and influencing senior leadership

Preferred:

  • You use AI tools daily to work faster and push what's possible

  • Knowledge of causal inference methods and advanced experimental design

  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI)

  • Experience in sustainability-focused or circular economy businesses

Location:

  • Berlin

  • Hybrid model (Must be willing to work from the office at least 2 days a week)


Purpose, a great company culture and incredible benefits - what to expect at rebuy:

  • Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time.

  • Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome.

  • Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed.

  • Enjoy our centrally located office in Berlin (Erkelenzdamm 11 - 13, 10999 Berlin).

  • Benefit from our family-friendly, flexible environment and paid child sick leave.

  • Bring your dog to the office: we love animals and want to cuddle yours, too!

  • Use employee discounts on rebuy.de, sustainable products at Futurebens, offers for sustainable micro-mobility and massages directly in our office.

  • Have fun at our legendary team and company events.

  • Use our mental health offers as part of a cooperation with Nilo. 

  • Take care of your work-life balance with 30 vacation days.

  • Stay active with our own gym located directly in the building, making it easy to fit workouts into your daily routine.

  • Benefit from an on-site daycare in the building, supporting a truly family friendly and flexible working environment.

*At rebuy all people are welcome and supported! We would like to talk, regardless of age, disability, national and social origin, skin color, religion, gender identity and sexual orientation. Just be who you are.

data.description:
Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen. 

Deine Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt.  

  • Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server.  

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen.  

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Nutze flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernarbeitszeit und arbeite in der Regel einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice. Individuell kann nach Absprache auch mehr Remote Arbeit möglich sein. 

  • 30 Urlaubstage: Profitiere von 30 Tagen Urlaub und individuellen Lösungen, wenn du darüber hinaus einmal eine längere Auszeit benötigst.  

  • Bonus: Zusätzlich zu deinem Fixgehalt erhältst du einen vom Unternehmenserfolg abhängigen Jahresbonus, der in erfolgreichen Jahren bereits bei mehreren Tausend Euro lag.  

  • Mobilität: Nutze das bezuschusste Deutschlandticket, JobRad, Firmenparkplätze, kostenloses Laden deines E Autos sowie Poolfahrzeuge für dienstliche Termine.  

  • Sport & Gesundheit: Profitiere von Hansefit, einem Boulderfelsen und einer Tischtennisplatte direkt am Standort sowie zahlreichen von Kollegen organisierten Aktivitäten wie Klettern, Mountainbiken oder Kajaken.  

  • Team & Events: Freue dich auf Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, gemeinsame Grillnachmittage auf der Dachterrasse sowie mehrtägige Entwickler Camps, bei denen bewusst neue Technologien und Themen ausprobiert werden.  

  • Weiterentwicklung: Erhalte individuell abgestimmte Weiterbildungen und einen Mentor aus einem anderen Unternehmensbereich als persönlichen Sparringspartner.  

  • Gehalt: Jahresbruttogehalt ab 60.000 € mit Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens. 

  • Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen.  

  • Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible.  

  • Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX.  

  • KI Infrastruktur: Betreue und erweitere den unternehmenseigenen Linux basierten KI-Server und schaffe eine sichere Infrastruktur für die interne Nutzung künstlicher Intelligenz.  

  • Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel. 

Dein Profil Systemadministrator Linux

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker, IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.  

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums.  

  • Sehr gute Linux Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest bereits routiniert mit Linux und möchtest dich nicht erst in das Betriebssystem einarbeiten.  

  • Solides Verständnis von Netzwerktechnik, Netzwerkprotokollen und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere.  

  • Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien.  

  • Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen.  

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.  

  • Eigenständige, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Lust darauf, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam im Team neue Lösungen auszuprobieren.  

  • Kenntnisse in Nextcloud, Open Xchange, Nginx, pfSense, OpenVPN, Git oder Ceph sowie Erfahrung mit IT Security sind von Vorteil. 

Du suchst keinen Job, in dem du nur Tickets abarbeitest, sondern möchtest eine Linux und Open Source Landschaft wirklich mitgestalten? 🚀 

Sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und erfahre in einem kurzen 10 minütigen Kennenlerngespräch mehr über das Unternehmen, die IT Landschaft und die Möglichkeiten, die du in dieser Rolle hast.

Your mission is to work hands-on with the parts of the aircraft that turn stored energy into flight: the

You want to do more than just contribute ideas — you want to actively shape a software product from the first concept through to release? As Product Owner at Relution, you take responsibility for the continued development of our “Made in Germany” UEM and MDM platform.

You will work closely with customers, Engineering, UX, Sales and Management. You understand requirements, challenge assumptions and work with the team to turn real problems into meaningful product solutions.

  • You translate requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria and support implementation from concept through to release
  • You work closely with our development teams in a technically demanding environment covering Apple, Android Enterprise and Windows
  • You work on topics such as device management, enterprise app management, security, identity, APIs and platform integrations
  • You collect feedback on new functionality and continuously improve existing features
  • You represent Relution as a product expert in customer and partner discussions, at trade fairs, webinars and training sessions
  • For complex functional or technical topics, you support the wider team and ensure that relevant insights feed back into the product

  • You have several years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or in a comparable role for a software product

  • You communicate clearly, enjoy working across different teams and take ownership of your topics

Your profile

  • You are given responsibility and the freedom to make your own decisions
  • We work closely together and value direct communication over lengthy coordination processes

Team Lead Sales Development

Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Deine Mission

Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln.

trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen.

Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen.

Über trawa

trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen.

Wir suchen eine:n Team Lead Sales Development (SDR), um gemeinsam die nächste Wachstumsstufe zu erreichen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Sales und arbeitest eng mit unseren Commercial-Teams zusammen. Du gestaltest das Produkt mit, das die europäische Industrie wieder wettbewerbsfähiger macht – und setzt deine Ideen mit hohem Tempo um.

Die Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt. trawa ist ein Office-First-Unternehmen: In der Regel arbeitest du an fünf Tagen pro Woche aus unserem Büro.

Das Team

Das trawa SDR-Team ist ein zentraler Wachstumstreiber des Unternehmens und einer unserer wichtigsten Kanäle zur Generierung neuer Kundenbeziehungen. Das derzeit sechsköpfige Team vereint vielseitige Erfahrungen im Vertrieb und schafft dadurch ein dynamisches Umfeld. Nach einer Phase starken Wachstums liegt der Fokus nun darauf, diesen Erfolg weiter auszubauen und gemeinsam den nächsten Wachstumsschritt zu gestalten.

Wen wir suchen

  • Als Player-Coach übernimmst du die Verantwortung für den Erfolg des SDR-Teams und bist gleichzeitig selbst operativ aktiv. Du verbringst den überwiegenden Teil deiner Zeit mit Cold Calling und gehst mit deiner eigenen Performance als gutes Beispiel voran.

  • Du verantwortest die Team-Performance ganzheitlich, steuerst die Zielerreichung und entwickelst das Team kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale in Prozessen und Strukturen, bringst die Perspektive des Teams aktiv ein und setzt gemeinsam mit den relevanten Stakeholdern im Unternehmen Verbesserungen um.

  • Du bist ein zentraler Bestandteil des Recruiting-Prozesses für neue SDRs und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Team für ein strukturiertes und erfolgreiches Onboarding neuer Teammitglieder.

Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du hast ein fundiertes Verständnis für unsere Produkte und den Energiemarkt aufgebaut.

  • Du hast dich als feste Ansprechperson für alle Themen rund um das SDR-Team etabliert.

  • Deine eigene Performance im Cold Calling setzt erste neue Maßstäbe.

  • Du hast erste Optimierungspotenziale zur Steigerung der Team-Performance identifiziert und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen abgeleitet.

Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Überzeugungskraft und hohes Durchsetzungsvermögen zeichnen dich aus.

  • Du kommst leicht mit Menschen ins Gespräch, verstehst Bedürfnisse und stellst passende Lösungen überzeugend vor.

  • Du gehst Aufgaben mit Eigeninitiative und klarer Zielorientierung an.

  • Du denkst analytisch und strukturiert: Komplexe Prozesse zerlegst du gerne in einzelne Schritte, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und Metriken.

  • Du hast umfangreiche Erfahrungen rund um vertrieblichen Methoden und Techniken.

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Warum trawa?

Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt.

Verantwortung: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung.

Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir stellen dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und feste Zeit für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung zur Verfügung. Dich erwarten Mentoring, vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und echte Perspektiven für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt.

Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. Menschen aus mehr als 15 Nationen bringen unterschiedliche Sprachen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Bei trawa ist Familienfreundlichkeit auf allen Ebenen selbstverständlich – in unserem Team und in der Führung arbeiten Eltern. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem alle ihr Bestes geben können.

Vergütung und Benefits: Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket mit Gehalt und Stock Options, 30 Urlaubstagen sowie zahlreichen Benefits. Dazu gehören Zuschüsse für Internet und Mittagessen, eine Mitgliedschaft im Sport Club, feste Lerntage mit jährlichem Weiterbildungsbudget, ein wöchentliches Team-Mittagessen und regelmäßige Teamevents.

Bei trawa bauen wir einen vielfältigen, inklusiven und authentischen Arbeitsplatz auf. Wenn dich die Position begeistert, dein bisheriger Weg aber nicht in allen Punkten dem Anforderungsprofil entspricht, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bist du genau die richtige Person für diese oder eine andere Position bei uns.

Unsere Mission für dich

Gestalte mit uns die nachhaltige Energieversorgung von morgen und werde Teil unseres wachsenden Operations-Teams! trawa baut Europas führende B2B-Plattform für saubere Energie auf. Unsere Mission ist es, Industriekunden mit nachhaltigen Energielösungen zu versorgen. Mit einem innovativen Ansatz, der Energieversorgung, fortschrittliche Energiemanagementsoftware und intelligente Optimierung von Energieverbrauchsdiensten kombiniert, helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, erfolgreich zu bleiben und den Weg in eine klimafreundliche Energiezukunft zu ebnen.

Das Team

Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, eingespielten Onboarding-Teams mit vier Personen. Als Teil des Business Operations Departments arbeitest du in einem Bereich mit insgesamt rund 20 Kolleginnen und Kollegen, zu dem auch das Customer Success Team gehört. Im Alltag verbindet uns eine enge, cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit, mit der wir gemeinsam die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden erzielen. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, denken mit und packen gemeinsam an. Gleichzeitig pflegen wir eine Teamkultur, die über den Arbeitsalltag hinausgeht – und eine Company Culture, auf die wir wirklich stolz sind.

Als Operations Intern (m/w/d) spielst du eine Schlüsselrolle im Aufbau von Prozessen und Strukturen eines aufstrebenden und schnell wachsenden Technologie-Startups. Wir stellen fortlaufend für eine Praktikumsdauer von 3–6 Monaten ein.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ownership für operative Prozesse: Du führst entscheidende operative Aufgaben in Eigenverantwortung durch und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Organisation in allen Kernbereichen reibungslos läuft.

  • Automatisierung von Prozessen: Du entwickelst Ansätze zur Effizienzsteigerung und Automatisierung von Prozessschritten.

  • Begleitung beim Onboarding: Du unterstützt bei der Einführung unserer Neukund:innen in das trawa-Universum und sorgst für eine exzellente Kundenerfahrung.

  • Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung der Organisation: Du gestaltest Prozesse aktiv mit und hilfst uns dabei, als Unternehmen weiter wachsen zu können.

  • Daten im Blick behalten: Du übernimmst die Datenpflege in unseren Systemen (z. B. CRM) und stellst durch sorgfältige Arbeit eine hohe Datenqualität sicher.

Nach wem wir suchen

  • Du bist Student:in, im Bachelor-Studium, Gap Year, Master-Studium oder Absolvent:in mit guten akademischen Leistungen.

  • Erste praktische Erfahrungen in Startups, anderen schnelllebigen Umfeldern oder der Energiewirtschaft sind ein starkes Plus.

  • Du denkst analytisch, fühlst dich wohl im Analysieren von Zahlen und kommunizierst datenbasierte Erkenntnisse sicher.

  • Organisationstalent zeichnet dich aus – du arbeitest strukturiert, behältst den Überblick und kannst Aufgaben effizient priorisieren.

  • Du besitzt eine generelle Affinität für digitale Tools wie z. B. CRM-Systeme, Notion, Google Workspace oder n8n.

Deine ersten 90 Tage:

Die ersten sechs Wochen – Orientierung und Einarbeitung

  • Lerne unsere Prozesse kennen – vom internen Handover der Neukunden von Sales, über die Anmeldung von Lieferstellen bis hin zur Marktkommunikation im komplexen Energiemarkt.

  • Mache dich mit den wichtigsten Tools, Systemen sowie internen und externen Ansprechpartnern vertraut, die beim Onboarding unserer Neukunden eine Rolle spielen.

  • Führe deine ersten Kunden-Onboardings eigenständig durch: Stelle die „Handover-Readiness" durch Sales sicher, richte das Kundenportal ein, initiiere den Kundenkontakt, melde Lieferstellen an und löse Probleme in der Marktkommunikation.

Bis zum dritten Monat – Verantwortung übernehmen und Prozesse weiterentwickeln

  • Übernimm Kunden-Onboardings eigenständig und verantworte Timelines sowie die Kommunikation mit allen Beteiligten.

  • Entwickle ein belastbares Verständnis für Marktkommunikationsprozesse und werde zur verlässlichen Ansprechperson bei Problemen in deinem Bereich.

  • Erkenne wiederkehrende Muster in typischen Fehlern und bring eigene Ideen ein, um unsere Onboarding-Prozesse gezielt zu verbessern.

Warum wir?

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss haben – auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und die Umwelt. Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • Dein Impact: Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unserem dynamischen Team und gestaltest aktiv innovative Produkte, die die Energiewende vorantreiben und zur Dekarbonisierung des Mittelstandes beitragen.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: In unserem schönen Office fördern wir eine lebendige Unternehmenskultur. Homeoffice ist ebenfalls eine Option. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Urlaubstagen und 10 Tagen Workation unterstützen wir deine Work-Life-Balance.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erhältst du Essensgutscheine, eine Urban Sports-Mitgliedschaft, reichlich kostenlose Snacks und ein persönliches Produktivitätsbudget.

  • Persönliche Entwicklung: Du bist Teil eines tollen Teams, wo Coaching und Mentoring groß geschrieben wird, und arbeitest mit Spitzentechnologien und lernst von Branchenexpert:innen.

  • Vielfalt & Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen – wir engagieren uns für einen integrativen Arbeitsplatz, der Vielfalt wertschätzt. Wir ermutigen Menschen unterschiedlichen Geschlechts, Alters, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sozialer Herkunft und körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung.

Über uns

Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen, entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen, und professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite.

Accounts Receivable Accountant

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

Our Mission For You

Own the process that turns invoices into cash, and shape how trawa's Finance function scales with our customer base.

trawa enables mid-sized industrial and commercial companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're in a hyper-growth phase in one of the most complex markets in Germany. It's a rare moment to join: the foundations are being built right now, the problems are real, and the room to shape how Finance runs at scale is wide open.

This is one of the most critical roles in the company. Cash is what enables trawa's growth, and you own the process that protects it. Every reconciliation you close, every overdue account you resolve, every dispute you clean up feeds directly into how fast we can move.

As our Accounts Receivable Accountant, you'll own the end-to-end AR and collections process. You'll be the person customers talk to when something on an invoice isn't clear, and the person internally who makes sure open items don't stay open. You'll work closely with Customer Success, Business Operations, and our Finance team.

If you're excited by ownership, an AI-first way of working, and building something that actually matters, this is your role.


What You'll Own

Collections and Dunning

  • Own the collections cadence end-to-end: monitor AR aging, prioritise the highest-impact accounts, and drive them to resolution via email and phone.

  • Reduce DSO measurably. You set the pace, we give you the tools and the mandate.

  • Manage our dunning process reliably and with the right tone: firm on cash, respectful of the customer relationshipDebitorenbuchhaltung und operative Prozesse.

Reconciliation and Cash Application

  • Reconcile incoming payments against open invoices, investigate and resolve unapplied cash, short-pays, and discrepancies.

  • Run structured reconciliations reliably, and independently drive ad-hoc analyses for complex payments or edge cases.

  • Support month-end close with AR reconciliations and clean aging reports.

Ticket Ownership and Customer Interaction

  • Take ownership of our AR ticket queue, which is currently high-volume and one of the most visible pain points across the company. You get on top of it, categorise what's coming in, and resolve the majority of tickets directly.

  • Be the go-to Finance contact for customers on all relevant topics: invoicing, payments, and account requests.

  • Work closely with Customer Success and BizOps to resolve customer issues end-to-end and make sure Finance topics don't get stuck between teams.


Who You Are

Must-haves

  • 3+ years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Collections, or Credit Control, or a comparable Finance role. Ideally in a high-volume and complex B2B environment

  • Solid understanding of AR processes: dunning, cash application, reconciliations, and month-end AR work.

  • Confident with customers in writing and on the phone. You can be firm on cash without damaging the relationship.

  • Strong ownership mindset. You don't wait for someone to flag a problem. You spot it, dig into the root cause, and drive it to resolution across stakeholders.

  • Structured, analytical, and detail-oriented. You keep complex open items straight without losing the bigger picture.

  • Business fluent in English and solid written German (customer correspondence in German needs to work reliably). Spoken German is a strong plus but not required.

  • Comfortable in the standard office and analytics toolset (Excel or Google Sheets) and able to navigate independently.

Nice-to-haves

  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a comparable field, or a solid vocational qualification (e.g. Bilanzbuchhalter:in IHK, Steuerfachangestellte:r, kaufmännische Ausbildung). We care about what you can do, not the badge on your CV.

  • Experience with AI-powered reconciliation tools or modern ticketing systems.

  • Genuine curiosity for AI and automation. Bonus if you've already used Langdock, Claude, or similar tools to speed up your own work.

  • Experience in a fast-growing start-up or scale-up environment.


Your First 90 Days

Month 1: Understand

  • Understand trawa's business model, customer base, and billing logic, including what makes energy billing genuinely complex

  • Map our AR process end-to-end (invoicing, collections, cash application, close) and get to know your key counterparts in Customer Success, BizOps, and Accounting

  • Take over recurring work: ticket triage, aging analysis, dunning follow-ups

Month 2: Take Ownership

  • Run the AR cycle largely independently: aging monitored proactively, customer follow-ups sent on time, accounts reconciled cleanly

  • Contribute to your first month-end close reliably and on time

  • Identify one concrete process gap in collections, reconciliation, or ticket handling, and come with a plan to fix it

Month 3: Build and Improve

  • You're the reliable Finance point of contact for customer-facing AR topics. The ticket backlog is under control and issues get resolved before they escalate

  • DSO is trending in the right direction and month-end contributions are delivered without follow-up

  • You've shipped at least one meaningful process improvement and can point to its impact

  • You're actively shaping how our AR processes scale as trawa's customer base grows


Why trawa?

  • Direct collaboration with Finance leadership and cross-functional leaders from day one. Short paths, real decisions, real ownership

  • A uniquely complex business at the intersection of energy, software, and B2B operations. You'll learn a lot, fast

  • An AI-first and automation-first Finance team. You'll set up scalable processes and drive them forward through process automation and larger tool implementations.

  • Real room to grow as trawa scales, your scope grows with the company.

  • Flexible working, 30 vacation days, L&D budget, competitive compensation, VSOPs (share package), meal vouchers, Urban Sports Club membership, and a vibrant office culture in Berlin

Diversity at trawa

Everyone is welcome here. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace that values diversity, and we encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, physical or neurodiverse background.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We value ownership, learning speed, and aren't hunger over a perfect CV.

🚀 YOUR OPPORTUNITY

Want real hands-on experience in B2B SaaS marketing — running webinars, shaping demand gen campaigns, and building the AI-powered systems that run our marketing team? Then it's an exciting time to join Luminovo!

We help electronics manufacturers and OEMs manage one of the most complex supply chains in the world by bringing sourcing, quoting, and procurement into a single, modern platform. As we scale, our marketing team needs more hands to keep webinars, campaigns, and content moving — and that's where you come in.

Here's what makes this opportunity different: we run "AI by default", and we're one of the first marketing teams making tools like Claude a daily habit, not a nice-to-have. You'll spend real time watching how the team works, spotting the recurring manual tasks, and building the automations and workflows that remove them. Nowhere else will you get this kind of head start on how AI is about to reshape marketing work.

We're hiring for this role in two flavors — pick whichever matches your situation:

  • Working student: 20h/week, ongoing

  • Intern: 3–6 months, full-time (with the option to convert to a permanent role)

Both cover the same scope and both start 01 September 2026, based hybrid out of our Munich office.

You won't be doing busywork. You'll cut the webinar clips that actually get watched, build the campaign assets that go live, help ship the case studies our sales team uses to close deals, and build the AI workflows that free up the whole team's time. You'll work directly with 7 people across the whole marketing team — so in a few months you'll have touched more of B2B SaaS marketing (and modern AI tooling) than most internships give you in a year.

If you're hungry, a fast learner, and want real mentorship instead of coffee runs, we'd love to hear from you!

👥 WHOM YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH

  • Mark, Head of Marketing

  • Isabela, Senior Content Engineer & Strategist

  • George, Demand Generation Lead

  • Cindy, Senior Product Marketing Manager

  • Iva, Senior Revenue Operations Manager (Marketing Ops)

  • Chris, Website Developer & Designer

  • Julie, Brand & Content Designer

  • Performance marketing agency

🎯 PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES

  • 🤖 AI & automation: observe the team's recurring, manual tasks and propose what's worth automating; build and ship real automations, workflows, and Claude skills and plugins the team actually uses; document and roll out new AI tooling once it works.

  • 🎙 Webinars & content: cut short clips from webinar recordings for LinkedIn, build Canva assets from existing templates, create CMS/on-demand entries for finished webinars, draft per-event email copy (invites, reminders, follow-ups) for review, draft social recap posts, and handle scheduling across the webinar calendar.

  • 📈 Field marketing & demand gen: campaign and list admin, processing event attendee lists, translation checks on ad assets (German), reporting & analytics support, and event prospect sourcing.

  • 🎨 Product marketing: supporting case studies and customer stories, producing sales enablement assets, product launch support, competitive research legwork, and keeping CMS entries updated and quality-checked.

💬 LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS

Fluency in German and English is a must. Our webinar program tilts US/UK, so your English needs to be excellent — German is needed for the DACH content stream and recap posts.

💡 SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, AND EXPERTISE

We purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. What matters most: you're currently studying (or recently graduated), curious about B2B/SaaS marketing, tech, and AI, and organized enough to juggle small recurring tasks across different stakeholders. No webinar or automation experience required — this is fully trainable, and being excited to get hands-on with tools like Claude, Canva, and our CMS Framer is a big plus. If you're interested in why we banned requirements from our job descriptions – see here: https://luminovo.com/resources/blog/why-we-banned-requirements-from-our-job-descriptions

About the Role at RobCo

The Role

RobCo goes to market across three streams: Alfie (our emerging, headline-making Physical AI product), Embedded Robotics, and Integrated Solutions. This role owns product marketing for the latter two — together the backbone of RobCo's current business. Embedded Robotics is our single largest source of net-new revenue today; Integrated Solutions is our large-deal, high-touch offering, often but not exclusively delivered together with partners.

This is a depth role. You'll get genuinely close to customers and verticals - automotive, food & beverage, electronics, plastics, and more - and turn that understanding into the content and enablement material that helps Sales (and our partners) actually close. RobCo already has a growing library of real deployments with measurable results; a large part of this role is turning that raw material into whitepapers, case studies, and video content people actually use.

Longer term, you'll help lay the groundwork for RobCoMMUNITY - the network of engaged customers and champions we're building across Embedded and Integrated. Finding and nurturing the customers willing to go public with their story is as much a part of this role as writing the story itself.

We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 2-3 days in office)

Pricing at Marshmallow

This role will sit in the Pricing Team, reporting into the Pricing Data Science Manager. The team is responsible for managing our loss ratio, underwriting footprint, broker optimisation and growth targets, proving integral to driving the business forwards. But you’ve probably read that all before! So what’s new?

We work in a very different way to most pricing teams that you might be familiar with. Everyone in Pricing has the potential to make significant contribution to the business, taking ownership, moving fast, innovating and delivering changes to our rates at high frequency.

We don’t just churn out GLMs all day. We build & deploy exceptional in-house pricing data science models using the latest modelling techniques. You’ll work alongside other Pricing Data Scientists & Analysts pushing innovative pricing projects, whilst also being able to work with the wider Data Science community on modelling customer behaviour, fraud & MLENG enhancements.

We work alongside a bunch of amazing engineers who ensure we can implement our decisions quickly. We also have access to huge amounts of data. We don’t just mean your standard policy, claims and quote data. Our engineers spend their lives building APIs to third parties so that we know more about our customers than any of our competitors.

All of this means that you’ll have access to as much data as you can handle, the freedom to be creative, the backing of senior leaders to make decisions, and the ability to see your ideas implemented rapidly. And on top of all of that, we’re a pretty fun group to hang around with!

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing a deep understanding of Marshmallow’s quote, policy and claims data and use this to derive insights that can be used to enhance our pricing.

  • Own one of the strategic initiatives of the pricing team, such as supporting our expansion plans or protecting our renewing customers.

  • Conducting claims analysis and claims modelling using SQL and Python.

  • Conducting price optimisation analysis/modelling using Python.

  • Building and deploying models in APIs for use in real time pricing.

  • Identify new sources of external data that enable us to refine our view of claims risk, and conduct analysis to quantify their value.

  • Working directly with our Engineering & MLENG functions to implement pricing proposals.

  • Providing pricing support for the launch of multiple new products.

Who are you?

  • Proactive: You drive growth by identifying & delivering new opportunities 

  • Modeller: You use your DS expertise to build innovative best in class models

  • Commercial: You directly use your models as tools to deliver timely real world impact

  • Curious: You aren’t satisfied with ‘That’s just how it is’; you immediately investigate further

  • Owner: You don’t just pull existing levers - you own end to end transformation in your area

  • Opinionated: You generate your own opinions & pitch to others in an open & honest way

  • Explainer: You can communicate complicated concepts in a simple way to non-experts

  • Networker: You build and maintain strong relationships throughout the business

What skills are we looking for from you?

  • Ability to interrogate data and conduct pricing analysis within SQL & Python/R

  • Ability to build GLMs, GBMs and other claims models within Python/R

  • At least 3 years of experience working in a data driven (ideally commercial) role

Perks of the job

  • Turn early wins into a repeatable approach. Build customer relationships, lead interviews and capture outcomes that become references and case studies. Use win/loss learning to sharpen our targeting, message and campaigns.

 

What you’ll bring

  • Around ten years of marketing experience, with a strong foundation in industry or product marketing and evidence of building markets and delivering commercial results.

  • Experience owning a marketing pipeline from planning through execution and reporting. You can build a model, understand funnel performance and explain what needs to change.

Clear priorities for Care Homes and Clinics, positioning that resonates with buyers, and a growing marketing pipeline. Weekly reporting explains what is happening, why it is happening and what the team will do next.

Light’s values are speed, simplicity and transparency. We make decisions when the evidence is sufficient, keep ownership clear and share progress and problems early. We expect leaders to raise the quality of the work, help colleagues succeed and use AI to remove unnecessary effort.

Hi 👋 I'm Chris. I'm a Lead Product Marketing Manager at hx - I joined over four years ago as a Product Marketing Manager. Outside of work you'll find me playing sport (badly), watching reality TV, or taking my dog Lucky to the park (or the pub!).

Product Marketing at hx is a highly strategic function. We shape the company's positioning and messaging, decide where and when products launch, and build the process that gets them to market.

This role comes with deep ownership over how we address our core audience: actuaries. You’ll need to go deep into the life and workflow of highly technical users and develop messaging, positioning, and content that neatly conveys the benefits of our solution.

You'll need to be comfortable managing senior stakeholders and have great taste - but what matters most is drive, and a willingness to solve problems as you find them. In return, you'll join a team that's kind, supportive, and full of very smart people who want to go fast and far. If that sounds like you, read on!

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

Marketing at hx operates at the intersection of demand generation, systems thinking, and constrained markets. We build authority and demand in a highly technical, niche space where every account matters. This isn't template-driven volume work - it's deep, strategic B2B marketing crafted for a known universe of accounts, and we stay involved from first engagement through to customer success.

As Product Marketing Manager for Calculation Engines and Portfolio Intelligence, you'll sit at the heart of how hx becomes the obvious choice for actuaries who want to price faster and steer their portfolio with confidence. You'll own the technical story for our developer community - the most demanding audience we serve - and be the connective tissue between Product, Revenue, and the AI team, turning user insight into sharp positioning, useful sales assets, and narratives that stand up to scrutiny from people who'll know immediately if they don't. Your work spans two distinct challenges at once: deepening engagement and value realisation for our established Calculation Engines product, whilst driving launch readiness, early adoption, and strong feedback loops for Portfolio Intelligence.

The team experiments constantly, uses AI to focus on strategy over busy work, and operates with a high bar for quality and pace. You'll be joining a group that takes work seriously but not themselves, where compressed learning is the norm and the most future-ready in your craft is the standard.

Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

Drive deeper engagement and adoption of Calculation Engines among existing users, using the usage data we now have to spot where users stall and creating messaging and enablement that moves them forward.

Own go-to-market execution for the Portfolio Intelligence release end to end - positioning, launch materials, enablement, and user communications that get it in front of the right people and drive real usage.

Accelerate early adoption of Portfolio Intelligence by creating onboarding support and launch assets that help target users get to first value quickly, evidenced by users moving out of the beta programme into sustained use.

Become the developer community's champion by writing technical content at a regular cadence that Solutions Engineering uses in live deals, and answering architecture and integration questions directly rather than routing them to Product.

Build hx's position in actuarial AI by developing differentiated positioning and up-to-date competitive understanding that works consistently across website copy, enablement, and customer conversations.

Establish strong feedback loops between users, Product, Revenue, and the AI team, so insight from launches, testing, and field conversations directly informs messaging, prioritisation, and product direction.

What you'll need to have done

Led product marketing in a B2B SaaS environment, balancing adoption work for an existing product with launch readiness for a new one at the same time - demonstrating commercial judgement across multiple GTM motions.

Increased engagement or adoption of a mature product by using user insight to sharpen messaging or enablement - with measurable improvement in usage, understanding, or qualitative feedback from users and revenue teams.

Owned a product launch end to end, including the internal readiness and enablement work that happens before it ships - not just the moment it goes out.

Turned a complex technical capability into credible, differentiated messaging for a skeptical, technical audience - developers or an equivalent evaluator population - built on real user insight rather than generic claims.

Worked hands-on alongside a Solutions Engineer or equivalent technical partner, comfortable being challenged on technical detail and holding your line, and earning trust across Product, Engineering, and Revenue without relying on formal authority.

Used AI with real judgement about when a technical claim is actually true rather than just plausible, and applied that judgement to rebuild how systems like enablement, competitive intelligence, or win/loss work - not just run them faster.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You expect full product maturity, clear roadmaps, and well-defined processes before taking action - hx moves fast and requires comfort operating in ambiguity where products, priorities, and messaging are still evolving.

  • You focus primarily on flashy launch work or brand campaigns rather than the detail-oriented, outcomes-driven work of deepening adoption, engagement, and user understanding.

  • You struggle to prioritise or make trade-offs without perfect information, waiting for others to decide rather than using judgment to move work forward with the context available.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Talent Screening (30 minutes)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)

  3. Skills Assessment & Panel (45 minutes)

  4. Values Interview (60 minutes)

  5. Meet the CEO/CPO/VP Eng (40 minutes)

  6. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies.   • We hold the bar: direct, ego-free feedback and standards that do not slip when it is busy.

Small team. Real ownership. No passengers.

If you are driven by pace, mastery, and being early to something that is about to get very big — this is the place.

Nylon is an AI-native tax and legal research platform used by 1,900+ accountancy and law firms across the UK, Australia and New Zealand. We were the first product accredited by ICAEW in the Legal Information and Research Software category, and we hold an ACCA affiliation. The UK business has been built almost entirely on outbound sales. It works, and it has taken us a long way. Now we want a second engine, and you would be the person who builds it.

This is our first dedicated marketing hire in the UK. There is no team beneath you yet and no playbook to inherit. There is a working sales motion, a product accountants and lawyers actually use, strong accreditation credentials, and a founder-led company that moves quickly. You will set the marketing strategy and then do most of the work yourself.

What you'll own

  • Pipeline. SEO and content, paid search and LinkedIn, email nurture, webinars and free-trial campaigns. Your number is qualified pipeline handed to our SDR and AE team, and you will be measured on it.

  • Brand and content. Sharpen how Nylon shows up in the UK accountancy and legal market: website, thought leadership, case studies, PR and awards, and the marketing side of our ICAEW and ACCA relationships.

  • Product marketing. Own the messaging. Turn what the product does into language that lands with a tax partner or a managing partner, keep our positioning against incumbent research providers sharp, and equip the sales team with battlecards, decks and one-pagers.

  • Events and community. Get us in front of the right people: ICAEW and ACCA events, industry conferences, our own roundtables and customer community. Some travel within the UK.

  • Measurement. Set up attribution and reporting in our CRM (Attio) so we know what is working, and kill what is not.

What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years in B2B marketing, with at least a few of those in SaaS or a subscription product, ideally selling to professional services (accountancy, legal, financial services).

  • You have built something from little or nothing before: a demand-gen function, a content programme, a launch. You are comfortable being the strategist and the person executing at 4pm on a Thursday.

  • Fluent in the tools: SEO and analytics, paid search and paid social, marketing automation and CRM, and the AI tools that make a small team punch above its weight.

  • You write well. Clearly, quickly, without fluff. Most of what marketing produces is words, and ours need to be credible to accountants and lawyers.

  • Commercially minded. You care about pipeline and revenue, not vanity metrics, and you enjoy working shoulder to shoulder with a sales team.

  • Curious about AI and about how professional services firms are changing. You do not need a legal or tax background, but you need to be able to learn the market fast.

Nice to have: experience marketing to accountants or lawyers; familiarity with ICAEW, ACCA or Law Society ecosystems; hands-on experience with webinar programmes or partnership marketing.

What we offer

  • £55,000–£70,000 base, depending on experience

  • Real ownership: you set the strategy, you get the budget, you build the team as we grow
