Wir suchen einen Partnerships Manager mit Drive, einem starken Netzwerk und einem tiefen Verständnis für den deutschsprachigen Markt. Du erkennst spannende Kooperationsmöglichkeiten, gehst proaktiv auf potenzielle Partner zu, entwickelst überzeugende Konzepte und verhandelst Partnerschaften, von denen beide Seiten profitieren.

Dabei übernimmst du den gesamten Partnership-Lifecycle – von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über Verhandlungen und Kampagnen-Launches bis hin zum langfristigen Beziehungsmanagement. Du analysierst, was funktioniert, optimierst kontinuierlich und skalierst erfolgreiche Partnerschaften.

Wenn du gerne mit Menschen arbeitest, Chancen erkennst, bevor andere sie sehen, und aus guten Ideen messbare Ergebnisse machst, könnte das dein nächster Step sein.

Diese Rolle ist zu 100 % remote und offen für Kandidaten mit Wohnsitz in Deutschland, Spanien, Portugal oder Großbritannien.

DEINE MISSION

  • Du baust strategische Partnerschaften in der DACH-Region und auf internationalen Märkten auf, entwickelst sie weiter und skalierst sie – von klassischen B2B-Kooperationen bis hin zu Influencer- und Creator-Partnerschaften.

  • Du identifizierst spannende Partner, sprichst sie proaktiv an und führst sie vom ersten Kontakt über die Verhandlung und das Onboarding bis hin zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

  • Du entwickelst kreative Partnerschaftskonzepte und Kampagnen, die zu unserer Marke, unseren Zielen und den jeweiligen Partnern passen.

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Partnership-Lifecycle – inklusive Verhandlungen, Briefings, Freigabeprozessen, Onboarding und laufendem Beziehungsmanagement.

  • Du bewertest potenzielle Partner anhand von Brand Fit, Zielgruppe, Content-Qualität und relevanten Performance-KPIs.

  • Du entwickelst neue Partnerschaftsmodelle und Kampagnen mit einem besonderen Fokus auf B2B-Partnerschaftensowie Revenue-Share-Kooperationen mit Influencer und Creators.

  • Du misst die Performance deiner Partnerschaften, leitest konkrete Insights ab und optimierst bestehende sowie zukünftige Initiativen kontinuierlich.

  • Du entwickelst skalierbare Prozesse innerhalb des Partnerships-Teams weiter und nutzt Automatisierung und Workflow-Optimierung, um effizienter zu arbeiten.

  • Du behältst auch die operativen Details im Blick – von Vertragsmanagement und Dokumentation bis hin zu Rechnungsstellung und administrativen Prozessen.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams und externen Partnern zusammen und stellst sicher, dass Kampagnen und Projekte reibungslos umgesetzt werden.

  • Du repräsentierst das Unternehmen auf Branchenevents, Konferenzen und Networking-Veranstaltungen und baust dein Netzwerk kontinuierlich aus.

  • Je nach Bedarf unterstützt du bei Influencer-Events und Creator-Aktivierungen.

DEIN PROFIL

  • Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Partnership-Management mit und kennst den DACH-Markt.

  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, B2B-Partnerschaften aufzubauen, zu verhandeln und langfristig zu entwickeln.

  • Erfahrung mit Influencern, Creators oder Content-Partnern ist ein großes Plus.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, souverän und authentisch und hast ein natürliches Talent dafür, Vertrauen und langfristige Beziehungen aufzubauen.

  • Du hast ein Growth Mindset: Du bist neugierig, ambitioniert und möchtest Dinge nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv weiterentwickeln.

  • Du bist kreativ und kannst aus einer Idee ein konkretes Partnerschaftskonzept oder eine Kampagne entwickeln.

  • Du arbeitest gerne eigenständig, bist gleichzeitig ein Teamplayer und fühlst dich in einem schnelllebigen, dynamischen Umfeld wohl.

  • Networking liegt dir: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, baust schnell neue Kontakte auf und pflegst dein Netzwerk aktiv.

  • Du bist proaktiv und selbstbewusst in der Ansprache potenzieller Partner – egal ob auf Events, per Telefon, LinkedIn oder E-Mail.

  • Du bringst starke Verhandlungsfähigkeiten mit und hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, Win-Win-Situationen zu schaffen.

  • Du bist energiegeladen, hands-on und hast echte Begeisterung für Partnerships, Influencer Marketing und die Creator Economy.

  • Du interessierst dich für Social Media, Content, Influencer Marketing und die Entwicklung der Creator Economy.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch und kannst dich sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich sicher ausdrücken. Weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

Wir suchen jemanden, der beide Welten versteht: den strategischen Aufbau wertvoller B2B-Partnerschaften und die Entwicklung von Kampagnen, mit denen Menschen tatsächlich interagieren möchten.

Dein Background könnte in Partnerships, Influencer Marketing, Creator Marketing, Brand Marketing, Business Development oder einer Kombination daraus liegen. Entscheidend ist für uns nicht dein exakter Jobtitel, sondern dass du Beziehungen aufbauen, Chancen erkennen und Partnerschaften in messbare Ergebnisse verwandeln kannst.

WARUM WIR?

  • Ein spannendes Produkt mit Millionen von Nutzern in über 150 Ländern, angetrieben von unserer Mission, die Welt durch gesunde Ernährung zu verändern

  • Ein Remote-First-Setup: Arbeite zu 100 % von zu Hause aus, nutze einen Co-Working-Space oder arbeite mehrere Wochen im Jahr im Ausland

  • 30 Urlaubstage zum Entspannen und Auftanken, plus 5 Kind-Krankheitstage, falls dein Kind dich braucht

  • Eine Teamkultur, in der Ambition und Ausgeglichenheit Hand in Hand gehen, unterstützt durch starke Verbindungen – von unserem vollständig finanzierten Firmenretreat bis hin zu Team-Meetups und virtuellen Kaffeepausen

  • Tools und Unterstützung, um deine beste Arbeit zu leisten: MacBook, Monitor und ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 €, dazu regelmäßiges Feedback und Karriereentwicklung

  • Ein wirklich internationales Team mit Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und einem gemeinsamen Bekenntnis zu Wachstum und Wohlbefinden – unterstützt durch Sunday Supplements und Nilo Health

DIVERSITY UND INKLUSION

Bei YAZIO glauben wir, dass Vielfalt Innovation antreibt. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem sich jeder – unabhängig von Geschlechtsidentität, Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder Fähigkeiten – wertgeschätzt und gestärkt fühlt. Wir feiern unterschiedliche Perspektiven und ermutigen aktiv Menschen aus allen Hintergründen, sich zu bewerben.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not an oversight one. You'll be in the call reviews, in the sequences, and in the numbers.

  • Partner with the AE team on handoff quality and meeting-to-opportunity conversion.

  • Build the path from SDR to Account Executive, and get people down it.

  • Experience leading an SDR or BDR team with direct accountability for a pipeline number.

  • A track record of team leadership with accountability for collective results, not just individual overachievement.

  • You were strong at outbound before you led it, and you can still get on the phone and show someone how.

  • Experience managing people across more than one location or time zone.

  • Comfortable building where the structure does not exist yet, and turning what works into a repeatable playbook.

You'll take ownership of the workstreams that keep this data accurate and our compliance process running smoothly. Think of it as detective work with real regulatory stakes.

As you settle into the core workflows, these opportunities naturally grow alongside you. Good ideas here don't just get heard, they get built.


About you

Location: Remote (Within +/- 2 hours of CET)

Not Your Typical Workplace.…

Tired of the 9-to-5 grind? Imagine a World without borders, where opportunities are endless. That's the future of work, and what we are building at WorkMotion.Our remote-first team spans across the world, helping companies hire, onboard, and manage talent internationally through smart, flexible workforce solutions. Fast-paced, people-driven, and globally connected — we empower businesses to build teams without borders.

More Than a Role.…

We don’t just need an Engineering Manager — a deep understanding of software engineering, can challenge technical decisions, coach engineers, improve engineering practices, and create an environment where teams consistently deliver meaningful outcomes. Do you enjoy building strong teams, have a strong Java engineering background, want to stay close to technology, and can turn ambitious product goals into reliable execution? We'd love to hear from you.

This isn’t a role for someone who wants to stay in their lane. You’ll be at the center of it all — ross-functional engineering team responsible for delivering reliable, scalable, and high-quality product capabilities. 

You won’t be a solo operator. You’ll collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering leaders, Principal Engineers, Platform, AI/ML, Security, and other stakeholders across WorkMotion bringing everything together to ensure consistency, impact, and momentum across the board.

You'll have the opportunity to solve technically and operationally complex problems at the intersection of global employment, payroll, compliance, automation, and AI, while helping shape how our Engineering organization operates as WorkMotion continues to grow. 

Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity…

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of software engineers, creating clear expectations and supporting their professional growth.
  • Own the team's delivery, execution, and engineering health, ensuring commitments are realistic and risks are identified early.
  • Partner closely with Product to translate business priorities into clear, executable technical plans.
  • Maintain strong technical awareness and actively participate in architecture, design, and engineering discussions.

  • Drive predictable delivery while balancing feature development, technical debt, scalability, and platform reliability.
  • Work with Principal and Senior Engineers on architecture and complex technical decisions.
  • Use engineering metrics and qualitative signals to continuously improve team effectiveness, quality, and delivery.
  • Identify dependencies and blockers early and coordinate effectively across teams.
  • Build a strong culture of ownership and accountability where engineers own their work from design through production.

What It Takes to Make an Impact Here…

  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and the Java ecosystem, with the ability to understand, review, and challenge technical implementations and architectural decisions.

  • Experience defining and using engineering effectiveness and delivery metrics, such as DORA metrics, flow metrics, quality and reliability indicators, to understand team health, identify bottlenecks, and drive continuous improvement—without using metrics as simplistic measures of individual performance.
  • Strong understanding of AI-assisted and agentic software development, with practical experience using modern AI coding tools and agents and the ability to help teams adopt them effectively across development, testing, code review, documentation, and other parts of the software delivery lifecycle.
  • Experience working closely with Product in an agile product-development environment.
  • Strong people-management skills, including coaching, feedback, performance management, and career development.
  • The ability to turn ambiguous business requirements into structured execution plans.
  • A data-informed approach to engineering performance without reducing productivity to simplistic metrics.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Professional fluency in English.

Our Engineering Culture…

  • Ownership over hand-offs Teams own outcomes, not just tasks.
  • Quality with speed We move quickly without treating engineering quality as optional.
  • Pragmatism over perfection We make deliberate trade-offs based on business and technical context.
  • Transparency Risks, mistakes, and disagreements should surface early. 
  • Continuous improvement Our architecture, processes, and ways of working should get better as we scale.
  • Collaboration Great products come from Engineering, Product, Design, Security, Data, and business teams working together.

The Perks of Being Here…

  • Global, remote, and thriving:  We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours.
  • Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day—a full day off just to recharge and relax.

  • Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in constant growth. With our Training & Development Allowance, you’ll have all the opportunities you need to keep expanding your skills and knowledge. 
  • Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups!

Intro

Empfehlungsbonus!❤ Kennst du jemanden, der/die perfekt zu dieser Stelle passt? Dann empfiehl uns die Person. Startet deine Empfehlung erfolgreich dieses Werkstudium bei GreenMedical, erhältst du als Dankeschön einen 100-€ Wunschgutschein.*



Zur CKM Group gehören eine Vielzahl von Unternehmen sowie eine Klinik, die alle dazu beitragen, unserer Vision von einer gesünderen Welt näher zu kommen.  
Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen. Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denken Gesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo. 

Ein neuer Pfeiler dieser Vision ist GreenMedical: Mit unserem telemedizinischen Service bieten wir einen einfachen und sicheren Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis, um Symptome zu lindern und die Lebensqualität zu verbessern. Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir Patienten bereits heute mit modernen Lösungen zur medizinisch begleiteten Gewichtsreduktion. Perspektivisch planen wir, unser Angebot um weitere Präventions- und Gesundheitsleistungen zu erweitern, um noch mehr Menschen individuell auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Gesundheit und Lebensqualität zu begleiten. 

Du willst im Venture Development durchstarten und konntest bereits erste Erfahrungen sammeln? Dann bewirb dich jetzt für ein Werkstudium und werde ein zentraler Akteur in der Entwicklung eines neuen HealthTech Ventures. Bringe deinen unternehmerischen Geist ein und hilf uns, innovativen Zugang zu Gesundheit zu ermöglichen.


Deine Mission bei uns

  • Markt-, Wettbewerbs- & Potenzialanalysen: Du führst Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Potenzialanalysen sowie Literatur- und Desk-Recherchen durch, identifizierst neue Wachstumsfelder und leitest daraus strategische Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
  • Geschäftsmodellentwicklung: Du wirkst an der Entwicklung und Validierung neuer Geschäftsmodelle mit und begleitest deren Weiterentwicklung bis zur Umsetzung.
  • Partnerschaften & Kooperationen: Du baust strategische Partnerschaften auf und entwickelst Kooperationen mit externen Stakeholdern strukturiert weiter.
  • Konzepte & Business Cases: Du bereitest Konzepte, Business Cases und Entscheidungsunterlagen adressatengerecht und überzeugend für interne und externe Stakeholder auf.
  • Projektsteuerung & Prozessentwicklung: Du analysierst Prozesse, strukturierst Anforderungen und steuerst Projekte eigenverantwortlich, um digitale Versorgungsangebote kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit & Eigenmotivation: Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Mindset, arbeitest proaktiv, übernimmst Verantwortung, denkst kreativ und bist bereit, für gute Ergebnisse die Extrameile zu gehen.
  • Analytisches & problemlösungsorientiertes Denken: Du kannst komplexe Fragestellungen strukturiert durchdringen, Kennzahlen und Business Cases aufbereiten sowie daraus fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten.
  • Selbstständige & strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, sorgfältig und organisiert, behältst auch bei Unsicherheit, wechselnden Prioritäten oder mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick und gehst Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert an.
  • Kommunikation & Informationsverarbeitung: Du kannst neue Informationen schnell erfassen, kritisch einordnen und adressatengerecht aufbereiten. Zudem kommunizierst du klar, arbeitest gerne im Team und gehst offen sowie konstruktiv mit Feedback um.
  • PowerPoint & Excel: Du verfügst über einen sicheren Umgang mit PowerPoint und grundlegende Excel-Kenntnisse zur Analyse und Aufbereitung von Daten.
  • Interesse am Gesundheitsbereich: Du begeisterst dich für den Gesundheitsmarkt, digitale Innovationen und HealthTech und möchtest die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen aktiv mitgestalten.
  • Praktische Erfahrungen: Idealerweise hast du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen im Business Development, Venture Development, HealthTech oder einem vergleichbaren dynamischen Umfeld gesammelt.
  • Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Gestaltungsspielraum & Eigenverantwortung: Bringe deine Ideen ein, übernimm Verantwortung und gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmen aktiv mit.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir arbeiten hybrid mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.
  • 31 freie Tage: 30 Urlaubstage plus jeweils halbe Arbeitstage an Heiligabend und Silvester.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit DYNO: Eine provisionsfreie bAV-Lösung, damit mehr von deiner Altersvorsorge dort ankommt, wo sie hingehört – bei dir.
  • Wellpass: Zugang zu deutschlandweiten Sport-, Fitness- und Gesundheitsangeboten – von Fitnessstudios über Yoga und Schwimmen bis hin zu Massagen.
  • Probonio & Corporate Benefits: Über unsere Mitarbeiterplattform erhältst du Zugang zu attraktiven Vergünstigungen, exklusiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und zahlreichen Rabatten.
  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeiten im Herzen von Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg mit Blick auf die Spree und eigener Dachterrasse.


Du hast Fragen? Wir sind für dich da.

Unser People & Culture Team begleitet dich während des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses und steht dir jederzeit zur Seite. Wenn du Fragen hast oder etwas unklar ist, melde dich einfach bei unserem Recruiting-Team unter ----- – wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören!

Die Empfehlung muss durch die Bewerberin oder den Bewerber im Online-Bewerbungsformular von GreenMedical über das Feld „Hat dich jemand empfohlen?“ angegeben werden. Andere Meldewege werden nicht berücksichtigt. Bei der Nennung mehrerer Personen entfällt der Prämienanspruch.

Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. 

We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.

As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x), this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.

If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Own:

  • Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.

  • Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.

  • Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.

  • Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.

  • Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.


What You Bring

  • Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.

  • Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.

  • Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.

  • Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.

  • High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.

  • Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.

  • Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.

  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.


Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

Why this role is exciting

Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows.

We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match.

We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job.

You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them.

What you will own and deliver

  • The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong.

  • Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap.

  • The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows.

  • The first training runs. Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations.

  • Judgment before spend. The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after.

The scope

This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it.

What we are looking for

  • PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry. Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted.

  • You can read a paper and reproduce it. Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall.

  • You know what policies train on. Familiar with the current robot-learning stack and policy classes well enough to know what the training side will demand of the data before the data exists.

  • Dataset instincts. You have trained on data you collected yourself, and you know the failure modes that only show up at training tim..

  • Comfortable as the only ML voice. You make the call, write it down, and revisit it when the pilot data says otherwise.

  • AI is how work gets done here. Our engineers use Claude Code and Devin daily, and we expect you to direct agents for the unglamorous parts — harness code, data plumbing, reproduction scripts — while keeping the quality bar exactly where it was.

  • Particularly relevant. Hand-pose estimation or egocentric video in production; multi-camera rigs and time sync; experience post-training robot-learning models; ROS 2.

What success looks like in 90 days

You have written the capture spec and we set up the first rigs against it. Your pilot gates have numbers, the first hours have passed your harness, and you can tell the people who sign the budget, with data, what the next hundred hours should look like.

Are we a good fit?

Take this role if you would rather own the spec that decides whether a dataset becomes an asset or a write-off than tune someone else's model on someone else's data, if a fulfilment centre at 6 a.m. sounds like a lab to you, and if you want the shortest possible line between your technical judgment and a capital decision. Read our culture code and are we a good fit?.

What we offer

  • The physical-AI side of the autonomous grocer, with the capture spec and the first training runs yours from day one

  • A data asset few teams in the world get to build, in fresh groceries, a domain as hard as manipulation gets

  • Off-the-shelf hardware, a managed cloud estate, and a mandate that has already started

  • Benefits — see what we offer

Are you in?

Instead of a cover letter: pick a published human-video-to-robot-policy pipeline you rate, and tell us where it breaks on a warehouse floor where every hand wears a work glove.

data.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your role

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services in Python that power our data access and distribution layer

  • Build and operate automated build, test, and deployment pipelines following CI/CD and GitOps practices, running on AWS and Kubernetes

  • Design and maintain data models and schemas (Avro, SQL) for our data pipelines and services, and publish them to downstream consumers via our Kafka-based distribution platform and schema registry

  • Build access-layer data models in our analytics environment (e.g., Snowflake) so applications can work with the data directly, including via API

  • Act as the coordination interface between the Data and Tech divisions, aligning priorities, schemas, and timelines across upstream and downstream teams

Your profile

  • 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related role.

  • Strong SQL skills and solid experience in data modeling (e.g., dimensional modeling, star schemas).

  • Hands-on experience with event streaming and message distribution, ideally Kafka, including schema management with the Kafka schema registry (Avro, Protobuf, or JSON Schema).

  • Experience designing data contracts and schemas between upstream producers and downstream consumers.

  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and modern data stack tools (e.g., dbt, CI/CD).

  • Openness to AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., Claude Code or similar).

  • Comfort working at the boundary of streaming/operational data and analytical data models, and building access layers that serve applications via API.

  • Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused and structured working style.

  • Interest in data governance, standards, and scalable data architecture.

  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus), with both technical and business stakeholders, combined with a solid understanding of business requirements and contexts.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

Founded in 2021 in Osnabrück, Germany, doinstruct is on a mission to empower the backbone of our society - the frontline workforce - by making workplaces safer, more compliant, and more efficient. We don’t just improve training; we redefine how industries onboard and upskill their teams.

The problem? Outdated, inefficient training methods that fail to meet the needs of the deskless workforce - the 80% of global workers overlooked by traditional learning solutions. We saw the gap and built a seamless, mobile-first platform that makes onboarding, training, and compliance effortless, multilingual, and accessible - anytime, anywhere.

At doinstruct, we don’t accept the status quo. We innovate, we challenge, we build. Our vision is bold: Operational excellence for frontline teams starts here. We cut through the noise of clunky, ineffective training with an engaging, user-friendly experience available in 35+ languages - no downloads, no passwords - just instant access to the skills that drive industries forward.

If you’re passionate about solving big problems, shaping the future of workplace learning, and working alongside a driven team that moves fast and thinks big, doinstruct is where you belong.

___

The role

This is a hands-on role, requiring native-level German and working English proficiency.

doinstruct builds software that helps organizations train and enable their frontline teams, the people in factories, logistics, and service environments who are hardest to reach with conventional L&D. Our customers are manufacturers, industrial operators, and traditional enterprises.

As a key part of our marketing team, you’ll get to flex your strategic, research, and creative skills writing and creating content with two specific goals: Educate our audience (Thought leadership) and convert them (Acquisition). You own both end-to-end.

You will create high-value content in the form of blog articles, case studies, landing page copy, and white papers, collaborating closely with internal subject matter experts. For shoots and videos, you’ll use your storytelling superpowers to develop concepts and manage external production partners.

AI is an expected part of your workflow. You leverage the speed and efficiency technology affords with the taste only humans possess to create credible content worth reading.

If you have a journalistic curiosity, understand B2B audiences, and know how to build a content engine from the ground up - let’s talk!

🎯 What you'll own

  • Translate frontline realities, industry insights, trends, analysis, and product communication into content that resonates with buyers who don't live in generic SaaS marketing.

  • Plan and produce content across formats (website, blog, video, social) that performs in both traditional search and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, and adjust based on what you’ve measured.

  • Use AI tools as your default production layer: drafting, repurposing, ideation, research, so you can ship more, faster, without sacrificing quality.

  • Brand tone of voice, ensuring consistency and differentiation

🙋 Who you are

  • You've produced content professionally and have a portfolio or examples.

(If your content workflow looks basically the same as it did two years ago, this probably isn’t for you.)

  • Bonus, not a requirement: you've worked with or around frontline, industrial, or blue-collar audiences and understand operator priorities.

🤩 What's different here

You're not maintaining an existing content machine; you're bringing a new brand strategy to life; experimenting; and building a content function. That means real ambiguity, but also a chance to have outsized impact on a rapidly scaling business.

🚀 Why doinstruct

  • 400+ customers, Series A funded, below 2% churn. The product is a genuine must-have, which gives you real stories to tell.

  • We're moving AI-first as a company and will actively help you get deeper into AI tooling, because that's the direction we're going.

  • You're joining a GTM org that's still forming its shape, so what you build sticks.

📈 What success looks like

3 months You've got a content production rhythm running across formats, you understand our frontline buyer personas firsthand, and you’re identifying opportunities.

6 months Content you've produced is showing up in AI answer engines for queries that matter to us, and you can point to the pipeline it's driving. You’ve established strong partnerships with stakeholders both internally and externally.

12 months There's a repeatable content engine that treats AI answer engines as a first-class channel alongside traditional search. Content is having a measurable impact on revenue.

Even if you don't tick all of the boxes, but you are motivated and want to work with us, you are very welcome to apply.

🌟 What we do & why we do it

Founded in 2021 in Osnabrück, Germany, doinstruct is on a mission to empower the backbone of our society - the frontline workforce - by making workplaces safer, more compliant, and more efficient. We don’t just improve training; we redefine how industries onboard and upskill their teams.

The problem? Outdated, inefficient training methods that fail to meet the needs of the deskless workforce - the 80% of global workers overlooked by traditional learning solutions. We saw the gap and built a seamless, mobile-first platform that makes onboarding, training, and compliance effortless, multilingual, and accessible - anytime, anywhere.

At doinstruct, we don’t accept the status quo. We innovate, we challenge, we build. Our vision is bold: Operational excellence for frontline teams starts here. We cut through the noise of clunky, ineffective training with an engaging, user-friendly experience available in 35+ languages - no downloads, no passwords - just instant access to the skills that drive industries forward.

🚀 Join us if you’re ready to build something extraordinary. We’re growing fast and looking for ambitious minds who thrive in a fast-paced, high-impact environment. If you’re passionate about solving big problems, shaping the future of workplace learning, and working alongside a driven team that moves fast and thinks big, doinstruct is where you belong.

___

The role

You'll sit next to doinstruct's founders, and you decide which workflows move to Claude agents, what ships to production, and what gets killed. Every project you take on has to clear one bar: a 3-5x return in hours saved, revenue generated, or headcount avoided. If it doesn't clear that bar, we don't build it.

This is full-time, in-office in Prenzlauer Berg at least 4 days a week, starting as soon as you can move.

  • Work directly with Charlotte and Mona on cross-functional initiatives across GTM, Product, and Ops.

  • Own launches end-to-end: brief, plan, execute, retro.

  • Pick your Claude tool by what the problem needs: Cowork for anything multi-step and messy, Code when something has to run, Sonnet or Opus for the genuinely hard stuff, Haiku for volume.

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

mission

As the Founders' Office Intern at telli, you'll work right alongside the founding team across finance, legal, ops, and special projects. You'll have a front-row seat to how an early-stage AI company operates and a very hands-on role in keeping things running and moving fast.

what you’ll do:

  • help us build the operational backbone behind telli's growth

  • take on special projects, driving initiatives forward by coordinating stakeholders and keeping everything on track

  • support with finance operations by maintaining reports, chasing invoices, and managing payment flow

  • help the growth team close new customers by managing legal and compliance processes

  • support with our hiring pipeline, from screening candidates to scheduling interviews

  • help plan and execute internal and external events and keep the office running smoothly

  • work closely with Ennie and Philipp

what makes you a great fit:

  • you are hands-on and not afraid of doing unglamorous work

  • you're tech- & automation savvy and can learn new tools fast

  • you love solving problems and figuring things out on your own

  • you’re a strong communicator in both English and German

  • you’ve have initial (internship) experience and/or worked on side hustles or projects

  • you're done or at the end of university and could imagine starting full-time after the internship

you may not make a good fit if:

  • you have never touched automation/AI tools or don’t have basic technical understanding

  • you only want to do high-level “strategic” work

  • you aren’t comfortable juggling multiple tasks at once

  • you don’t enjoy working directly with customers or in dynamic environments

  • you’re only looking for a typical 9–5 internship

Compensation: €3K – €5K per month

Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows, helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role

You will take Langdock from first conversation to signed contract. Our customers are IT leaders, security teams, and C-Level executives at mid to large companies worldwide. This role is pivotal in driving our expansion across diverse customer segments, from innovative scale-ups and SMBs to established Global Fortune 500 clients.

You'll operate as a trusted technology and AI advisor, combining full ownership of the sales cycle with the technical depth to build real credibility with today's technical buyers - the IT leads, architects, and engineers who now sit at the table alongside business executives in every AI decision. The product sells well, but enterprise deals require someone who can navigate architectural complexity, build trust with both business and technical stakeholders, and close.

What You Will Do

  • Full-Cycle Sales Mastery: Own the entire sales lifecycle from lead qualification to closing, running technical discovery, solution scoping, and executive presentations that tie Langdock's platform to measurable business outcomes - with a seamless handover to customer success.

  • Technical Credibility: Lead early-stage conversations on APIs, integrations, and system architecture directly with IT and engineering stakeholders, translating what Langdock can do at the platform level into business value for economic buyers - without leaning on a Solutions Engineer to carry the technical thread.

  • Customer Success Advocacy: Build a deep understanding of customers' business models, decision-making processes, and technology landscapes, and continuously analyze customer needs to enhance their success with our solutions.

  • Strategic Revenue Development: Collaborate with partnerships, marketing, and customer success to design effective go-to-market strategies, test new markets and customer segments, and explore new revenue sources for future growth.

  • Market Insight: Deep understanding of our Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) and the ability to align solutions with their needs - and provide customer feedback to Product and Leadership to influence the roadmap.

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You are proficient in AI technologies, with a preference for those who have previously sold AI solutions. In the best case, you have worked as a Sales Engineer or in similar positions.

  • You have experience selling technical solutions to medium and large companies, with the ability to translate complex platform concepts into business value for non-technical executives. You're comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles by developing and executing account strategies that carry significant quota.

  • You know how to build deep, strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-suite executives, while staying credible with the technical evaluators in the room.

  • You're curious and customer-centric, with a talent for understanding customers' challenges and coordinating solution design tailored to their needs.

  • You're comfortable operating in a high-growth environment.

  • You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.

The Environment

We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.

Days start at 8:30. Lunch & dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.

The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

Compensation

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity.

We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

Next steps

We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

data.description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role

We’re hiring a hands-on Security Lead to strengthen the security of Langdock’s product, infrastructure, and internal systems.

Your primary focus will be application and infrastructure security. You’ll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to identify risks, assess our defenses, and drive practical improvements. You’ll coordinate penetration tests, triage incoming vulnerability reports, and make sure findings turn into lasting fixes. You should be comfortable getting into technical details, challenging assumptions, and helping engineers choose the right controls.

You’ll also own the security of our internal IT environment, including identity, access, and device security. We’re looking for someone who builds reliable, automated processes and can judge whether our protections are effective.

Alongside this technical work, you’ll help explain our security posture to customers and support our compliance efforts. The foundation of this role is making Langdock secure; audits and customer assessments should reflect that work.

What You Will Do

The role's responsibility will span over multiple fields, which are:

Application security

  • Coordinate penetration tests end to end. Define scope with engineering and external testing partners, support testing, assess findings, and follow remediation through to verification.

  • Own vulnerability intake and triage. Monitor our security inbox and responsible disclosure program, assess reported issues, and work with engineering to prioritize and resolve them.

  • Help engineering build securely. Review security-sensitive designs and changes, identify weaknesses in areas such as authentication, authorization, and data isolation, and recommend practical improvements.

Infrastructure security

  • Assess and improve our security posture. Work with engineering to evaluate how our production infrastructure and internal systems are protected, identify gaps, and drive improvements.

  • Strengthen network and access controls. Review network separation, service exposure, privileged access, and permissions so systems and data are accessible only where needed.

  • Verify that controls work in practice. Look beyond configuration checklists to understand how systems could be compromised and whether our protections would prevent or detect it.

Internal security and automation

  • Own identity and device security. Ensure we have effective MFA, appropriate access policies, and properly managed, encrypted, and patched devices.

  • Automate the employee lifecycle. Build dependable processes for account provisioning, access changes, offboarding, and access reviews across Entra ID and our internal tools.

  • Keep recurring work manageable. Use scripts, integrations, and AI tooling to automate security operations and surface issues that need attention.

Customer assurance and compliance

  • Support customer security assessments. Help answer questionnaires and join customer conversations that require a clear, technically credible explanation of our security controls.

  • Contribute to our compliance programs. Support our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II work through effective controls, current evidence, and technical input into audits and risk assessments.

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • Hands-on application and infrastructure security experience. You understand how modern SaaS applications and cloud environments are built, where they can fail, and how to protect them.

Build Your Own Sales Business with Omada.ai

Omada.ai is the AI-powered marketing platform built for small businesses. We handle social media, email marketing, ads, and reputation management — so local business owners can stop being reluctant marketers and get back to doing what they love.

We’re venture-backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital, growing fast, and looking for independent, ambitious sales partners across the UK who want to earn serious money introducing local businesses to Omada.

The Opportunity

This isn’t a job — it’s a partnership. As an Omada Territory Sales Partner, you run your own independent sales operation. You choose your hours, your territory, your approach. We provide the product, the resources, and a compensation structure that means you’re never working for free.

  • Guaranteed Weekly Draw: £500/week guaranteed minimum — as long as you’re hitting your trial targets. This isn’t commission-only.

  • Commission: £250–£350 per closed account (tier-dependent) with uncapped earnings. Top partners earn £4,000–£8,000+ per month.

  • Structure: Self-employed (sole trader or limited company). You invoice us. You manage your own tax.

  • Location: Your local city. Must be based in the United Kingdom.

  • Schedule: Entirely your own. Work when it suits you — mornings, evenings, weekends. Your business, your call.

How the Draw Works

We believe in setting our partners up for success. That’s why every Territory Partner receives a guaranteed weekly draw of £500 — as long as you’re generating results.

  • Weeks 1–4: Generate at least 3 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week

  • Week 5 onward: Generate at least 4 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week

  • In any week where your commissions from closed accounts exceed £500, you earn the full commission instead

  • The draw is ongoing — not just for your first month. Hit your numbers, get paid. Every week.

This means you’re never working for nothing while your pipeline builds. Trials convert to paying customers, commissions grow, and the draw becomes your floor — not your ceiling.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be visiting local businesses — salons, restaurants, gyms, coffee shops, pet groomers, dental practices — and showing them how Omada.ai can handle their marketing while they focus on running their business.

A typical approach might look like this:

  • Identify businesses in your area that could benefit from better marketing

  • Walk in and start a conversation — "Hi, I work with Omada.ai. Who handles your social media?"

  • Show a quick demo on your phone

  • Offer a 14-day free trial — no risk for them

  • Follow up — when they convert, you earn your commission

We provide a resource kit with demo scripts, objection-handling guides, and territory mapping tools. How you use them is entirely up to you.

Who Thrives as a Territory Partner

  • Self-starters who don’t need someone managing their diary

  • People comfortable walking into a business and starting a conversation

  • Entrepreneurial types who want to build something, not just clock hours

  • Anyone with sales, field marketing, or B2B experience (helpful but not required)

  • People who want uncapped income tied to their effort, not a salary cap

What You’ll Need

  • UK-based with the right to work in the United Kingdom

  • Registered (or willing to register) as self-employed with HMRC

  • Smartphone with internet access

  • Reliable transport or a walkable territory with high business density

  • The drive to build your own business

No degree required. No prior sales experience required. If you can hold a conversation and you’re willing to put in the work, we’ll provide the resources to help you succeed.

The Career Path

Omada Sales Territory Partners aren’t capped. Top performers progress through a clear leadership pathway with increasing commission rates, territory ownership, and team-building opportunities:

  • Territory Partner — You’re in the field, closing deals, building your reputation.

  • City Captain — Exclusive city territory, higher commissions, and the opportunity to mentor new partners.

  • State Director — Leading a regional team with override commissions on your team’s closes.

  • Regional Director — Multi-region leadership with premium compensation.

  • Country Manager — Running Omada’s field operation for an entire market.

About Omada.ai

We’re an AI-powered marketing platform built specifically for small businesses. We handle social media, email marketing, ads, and reputation management — so business owners can stop worrying about marketing and focus on what they do best.

We’re backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital, growing across the UK, and building a network of Territory Partners who want to win.

Ready to start? Apply now

Self-employed contractor opportunity. Equal opportunity partner programme.

Compensation: £4K – £8K per month • Offers Commission

data.description:
The Opportunity: Zero-to-one category creation for AI-Native Zero Trust Access

Cipherscale is building an AI-native Zero Trust access and enforcement plane for humans, software/workloads, and AI agents.

The product doctrine is simple: AI may reason and propose; deterministic policy authorizes; trusted enforcement executes.

We are looking for a commercial founder/operator who can turn that architecture into a category, a repeatable customer problem, real deployments, and initial revenue.

Mission: discover and prove the repeatable commercial truth for Cipherscale - who urgently needs it, what gets them to deploy, what makes them pay, and what causes them to expand.

What You Own

• Own ICP discovery, exclusion criteria, buyer/champion mapping, problem validation, positioning, initial wedge, and design-partner recruitment.

• Personally lead early customer discovery, technical/commercial conversations, executive outreach, design-partner conversion, and initial closing.

• Build an evidence-driven GTM system: every important assumption has supporting/contradicting evidence and a next falsification test.

• Use AI agents aggressively for research, account intelligence, personalization, competitive monitoring, meeting preparation, call synthesis, content, and experiment analysis.

• Work directly with the CEO on category creation and major strategic accounts.

• Work with Product and Engineering to convert recurring customer evidence into governed product inputs - without turning prospect anecdotes into roadmap commitments.

• Define the first repeatable acquisition, deployment, conversion, and expansion motion before scaling a team.

What This Role Is Not

• It is not a traditional marketing leadership job.

• It is not an MQL, impressions, content-calendar, or brand-campaign role.

• It is not a decision to hire SDR, demand-gen, content, and marketing-ops teams before product-market evidence exists.

• It is not ownership of OpenVPN growth. Rod, Head of Growth, owns the established-business growth mandate;

This role is focused on Cipherscale zero-to-one GTM and must collaborate cleanly without duplicating authority.

Important:

  • This is a full-time remote job, and it will be a long-term B2B contract.

  • This can be a permanent employment opportunity for candidates based in Spain, Poland, and Germany.

Our philosophy is that we are a small, close-knit team, and we care deeply about you:

  • Highly competitive salary + Bonus

  • Fully remote work environments.

  • Self-managed time off.


Who We Want

• You have personally helped take a deeply technical B2B security, infrastructure, identity, developer, cloud, or AI

product from near-zero to repeatable initial revenue.

• You can sit with a CISO, CTO, security architect, platform engineer, and AI-platform leader and earn credibility.

• You understand enough security architecture to reason about identity, delegated authority, credentials, policy,

enforcement, trust boundaries, auditability, and blast radius.

• You are comfortable selling before there is a polished playbook and learning directly from rejection.

• You treat AI as operating leverage. Your instinct is to build agentic workflows before asking for headcount.

• You are analytical enough to distinguish activity from evidence and evidence from causality.

• You are comfortable challenging the CEO and product assumptions when customer evidence disagrees.

Strong Background Signals

• Early-stage Zero Trust, identity, cloud security, developer security, infrastructure security, AI security, developer infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise-security categories.

• Founder, first-GTM, product-led commercial operator, technical seller, or hands-on GTM executive backgrounds can all fit.

• Large-company titles alone are not compelling.

Anti-Profile

• Your first answer to a growth problem is "hire a team."

• You depend on agencies for core positioning or customer discovery.

• You optimize lead volume before proving deployment and retention.

• You cannot personally run technical discovery or executive selling.

• You treat AI as a copywriting assistant rather than an operating system.

• You blur probabilistic AI recommendations with authorization or security enforcement.

First 90 Days: Window Expected outcome

• 0-30 days: 10-15 qualified ICP conversations; ~5 credible design-partner candidates; evidence-backed recommendation on ICP, problem, buyer, positioning, and wedge.

• 31-60 days: Convert the strongest partners into real or production-like deployments; measure time-to-value, blockers, security objections, and willingness to pay.

• 61-90 days: Target 5+ production or production-intent deployments where product readiness permits; first paying customers; prove or disprove repeatability with a second cohort; document the acquisition/onboarding motion.

How Success Is Measured

• Business: paid customers, initial ARR/MRR, expansion and eventually defensible unit economics.

• Customer: time-to-first-value, production activation, repeated authorized usage, protected resources/principals,

retention and expansion.

• Funnel: qualified conversations -> design partners -> deployments -> production -> paid -> expansion.

• Learning velocity: experiment cycle time, evidence quality, speed at which weak assumptions are killed or corrected.

Operating Model and Reporting

This role works directly with the CEO during zero-to-one discovery and partners closely with Rod, Head of Growth.

Decision rights will be explicit: CipherScale market discovery cannot become an overlapping second growth

organization, and OpenVPN growth priorities cannot dilute CipherScale category discovery. As the motion becomes

repeatable, responsibilities can be consolidated based on evidence rather than titles.

Security Expectations

You will operate with customer and prospect data, AI agents, email/CRM systems, call transcripts, and potentially

technical environments. Treat agents as potentially compromised actors. Use scoped identities, least privilege,

deterministic authorization for external actions, credential isolation, customer-data boundaries, prompt-injection

defenses, audit trails, and human approval for high-impact commitments until explicitly delegated.

Compensation Philosophy

We would rather pay exceptional compensation and meaningful upside for one outstanding founder-level operator

than assemble a large conventional GTM organization. Final structure should reflect experience, location, scope, and

demonstrated ability to create zero-to-one enterprise value.

The Test

A strong candidate should be able to take the Cipherscale thesis, identify the first market to attack, design the first ten

customer experiments, explain what evidence would invalidate the strategy, and show how they would use AI to

execute the work with minimal human headcount.

The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Spotify Search handles billions of queries across every market, language, and content type — music, podcasts, audiobooks, videos, playlists, and more. We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the Search Personalization within our Conversation Product Area, setting the product strategy for how hundreds of millions of users find and discover content on Spotify. This is a leadership role at the intersection of search systems, AI, and user experience. You’ll own the end-to-end strategy for search results — from ranking and relevance to AI-powered features like semantic search, LLM reranking, and AI Overviews — while leading two key Search squads (results ranking and query suggestions). Search is the front door to Spotify; this role shapes what people find when they walk through it.

What You'll Do
  • Set the product strategy and multi-cycle roadmap for Search Personalization at Spotify — spanning ranking, relevance, retrieval, AI-native features, quality, and trust.
  • Drive the evolution of Search toward AI-native experiences — AI Overviews, semantic search, LLM reranking — balancing innovation velocity with quality and cost discipline.
  • Own the Search quality bar: define how relevance, trust, compliance, and user experience connect into a holistic quality framework with measurable outcomes.
  • Manage Search’s role as a shared surface across many company strategies — build prioritization frameworks, communicate trade-offs, and represent Search at executive forums.
  • Influence and coach junior PMs working in Search.
  • Partner with engineering leadership to make architectural decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term Search infrastructure health.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment where Search intersects.

    • Who You Are
  • You have 8+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years leading search, discovery, or information retrieval products at scale (100M+ users).
  • You have a deep technical understanding of search systems — ranking architectures, retrieval strategies, evaluation methodology, and the trade-offs between relevance, latency, cost, and freshness.
  • You have experience with AI/ML-powered search features — semantic search, LLM-based reranking, recommendations, or similar — and can lead a team through the transition from traditional to AI-native search.
  • You have a track record of managing complex stakeholder landscapes with competing priorities and limited resources, and can build frameworks for principled prioritization.
  • You think strategically at the portfolio level — you can synthesize across many concurrent initiatives, set a coherent vision, and communicate it clearly to executives.
  • You communicate with clarity and conviction, with the ability to translate technical complexity into compelling narratives for leadership, bet owners, and cross-functional partners.
  • You have experience mentoring and developing early-career PMs, and can influence without authority or direct reporting lines.
  • You bring familiarity with music, audio, or media technology and understand the unique dynamics of content-rich platforms.
  • You have experience operating Search as a platform that serves multiple internal teams or content verticals.
  • You have worked in content integrity, trust & safety, or regulatory compliance in the context of search or discovery systems.

    • Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
    • Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
     
    At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AWS Cloud Infrastructure Architect with IRS MBI Clearance based in United Kingdom.

This role is responsible for designing and managing secure, scalable AWS cloud infrastructure across complex multi-account environments.
You will shape cloud architecture spanning account governance, networking, identity and access management, security, and compliance.
The position requires hands-on expertise with AWS Organizations, Control Tower, Landing Zone Architecture, and GovCloud environments.
You will help establish resilient cloud foundations while supporting stringent regulatory and security requirements, including FedRAMP.
Working closely with engineering and security teams, you will provide architectural guidance and help drive infrastructure best practices.
The role also includes infrastructure automation, cost optimization, disaster recovery, and technical documentation.
This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on the reliability, security, and scalability of a mission-critical cloud environment.


Accountabilities:
  • Design and implement AWS account structures using AWS Organizations, including Organizational Units aligned with business and technical requirements.
  • Establish account governance policies, standards, consolidated billing, and cost allocation strategies.
  • Deploy and manage AWS Control Tower for automated account provisioning, governance, and organizational controls.
  • Design and implement Landing Zone Architecture for secure, scalable, multi-account AWS environments.
  • Architect and deploy multi-region VPC environments, including subnets, route tables, network ACLs, and network segmentation strategies.
  • Configure and manage Site-to-Site VPN, Client VPN, AWS Direct Connect, and Transit Gateway connectivity.
  • Design hybrid and multi-VPC networking solutions and manage DNS through Amazon Route 53.
  • Architect network solutions for AWS GovCloud environments.
  • Design and implement IAM policies, roles, permission boundaries, identity federation, and organization-level Service Control Policies.
  • Establish least-privilege access models and MFA requirements while maintaining IAM governance and compliance frameworks.
  • Develop and implement organization-wide security policies, monitoring, and incident response procedures.
  • Configure and manage AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, AWS Config, CloudTrail, WAF, and Shield.
  • Implement encryption strategies for data at rest and in transit and support vulnerability management and security assessments.
  • Maintain security and compliance controls aligned with SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, and other applicable frameworks.
  • Design and maintain security architectures for AWS GovCloud regions.
  • Build infrastructure as code using CloudFormation, Terraform, or CDK.
  • Maintain comprehensive architecture documentation, diagrams, standards, and technical guidance.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams on AWS architecture and cloud best practices.
  • Participate in disaster recovery planning, testing, and resilience initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize AWS costs, resource utilization, and overall infrastructure efficiency.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of experience in cloud architecture, including at least 3 years of hands-on AWS experience.
    • Deep understanding of AWS Organizations, multi-account architectures, and cloud governance strategies.
    • Hands-on experience deploying and managing AWS Control Tower for account orchestration and governance.
    • Proven experience designing and implementing AWS Landing Zone Architecture.
    • Experience working with AWS GovCloud (US) environments.
    • Strong knowledge of FedRAMP requirements, security controls, and authorization processes.
    • Expert-level understanding of AWS networking services, including VPC, VPN, Direct Connect, and Transit Gateway.
    • Strong expertise in IAM policy design, permission management, identity federation, and least-privilege architectures.
    • Demonstrated experience implementing cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks.
    • Proficiency with infrastructure as code technologies such as CloudFormation, Terraform, and/or AWS CDK.
    • Experience with AWS security and monitoring services, including Security Hub, GuardDuty, Config, and CloudTrail.
    • Strong understanding of encryption, security monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response.
    • Ability to translate complex infrastructure and security requirements into scalable architectural solutions.
    • Strong technical communication, documentation, problem-solving, and mentoring skills.
    • IRS MBI clearance is required.
    • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional is preferred.
    • AWS Certified Security – Specialty and AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty certifications are preferred.
    • Additional AWS certifications are a plus.

      • Benefits:

      • Annual salary of $150,000–$170,000.
      • Fully remote position.
      • Full-time employment.
      • Opportunity to work on complex AWS cloud architecture and multi-account environments.
      • Exposure to AWS GovCloud, FedRAMP, cloud security, governance, and compliance initiatives.
      • Opportunity to provide technical leadership and influence cloud infrastructure strategy.
      • Work involving modern AWS automation, infrastructure as code, networking, and security technologies.
